verses.zh: 同着撒拉铁的儿子所罗巴伯和耶书亚回来的祭司与利未人记在下面：祭司是西莱雅、耶利米、以斯拉、
verses.en: These are the priests and Levites who returned[NOTE:1] with Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel and Jeshua: Seraiah, Jeremiah, Ezra,
notes: Heb “who went up.”

verses.zh: 亚玛利雅、玛鹿、哈突、
verses.en: Amariah, Malluch, Hattush,

verses.zh: 示迦尼、利宏、米利末、
verses.en: Shecaniah, Rehum, Meremoth,

verses.zh: 易多、近顿、亚比雅、
verses.en: Iddo, Ginnethon,[NOTE:1] Abijah,
notes: Most Hebrew MSS read “Ginnethoi”; the present translation follows a number of Hebrew MSS and the Vulgate (cf. Neh 12:16 and NIV, NCV, NLT).

verses.zh: 米雅民、玛底雅、璧迦、
verses.en: Mijamin, Moadiah, Bilgah,

verses.zh: 示玛雅、约雅立、耶大雅、
verses.en: Shemaiah, Joiarib, Jedaiah,

verses.zh: 撒路、亚木、希勒家、耶大雅。这些人在耶书亚的时候作祭司和他们弟兄的首领。
verses.en: Sallu, Amok, Hilkiah, and Jedaiah. These were the leaders[NOTE:1] of the priests and their colleagues[NOTE:2] in the days of Jeshua.
notes: Heb “heads” (so also in v. 12).
Heb “brothers” (also in vv. 8, 9, 24, 36).

verses.zh: 利未人是耶书亚、宾内、甲篾、示利比、犹大、玛他尼。这玛他尼和他的弟兄管理称谢的事。
verses.en: And the Levites: Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah, and Mattaniah, who together with his colleagues[NOTE:1] was in charge of the songs of thanksgiving.
notes: Heb “he and his brothers.”

verses.zh: 他们的弟兄八布迦和乌尼照自己的班次与他们相对。
verses.en: Bakbukiah and Unni,[NOTE:1] their colleagues, stood opposite them in the services.
notes: The translation reads וְעֻנִּי (veʿunni) with the Qere rather than וְעֻנּוֹ (veʿunno) of the MT Kethib.

verses.zh: 耶书亚生约雅金；约雅金生以利亚实；以利亚实生耶何耶大；
verses.en: Jeshua was the father of[NOTE:1] Joiakim, Joiakim was the father of Eliashib, Eliashib was the father of Joiada,
notes: Heb “begat.”

verses.zh: 耶何耶大生约拿单；约拿单生押杜亚。
verses.en: Joiada was the father of Jonathan, and Jonathan was the father of Jaddua.

verses.zh: 在约雅金的时候，祭司作族长的西莱雅族（或译：班；本段同）有米拉雅；耶利米族有哈拿尼雅；
verses.en: In the days of Joiakim, these were the priests who were leaders of the families: of Seraiah, Meraiah; of Jeremiah, Hananiah;

verses.zh: 以斯拉族有米书兰；亚玛利雅族有约哈难；
verses.en: of Ezra, Meshullam; of Amariah, Jehohanan;

verses.zh: 米利古族有约拿单；示巴尼族有约瑟；
verses.en: of Malluch,[NOTE:1] Jonathan; of Shecaniah,[NOTE:2] Joseph;
notes: The present translation reads with the LXX לְמַלּוּךְ (lemallukh) rather than לִמְלוּכִי (limlukhi) of the Kethib (by dittography) or לִמְלִיכוּ (limlikhu) of the Qere.
Most Hebrew MSS read “Shebaniah” (cf. KJV, NAB, NASB, NRSV, CEV); the present translation follows the reading of some Hebrew MSS, some LXX MSS, and the Syriac (cf. Neh 12:3 and NIV, NCV, NLT).

verses.zh: 哈琳族有押拿；米拉约族有希勒恺；
verses.en: of Harim, Adna; of Meremoth,[NOTE:1] Helkai;
notes: The present translation reads with the Lucianic Greek recension and the Syriac Peshitta לִמְרֵמוֹת (limremot, cf. NAB, NIV, NCV, NLT “Meremoth”) rather than the MT reading לִמְרָיוֹת (limrayot, cf. KJV, NASB, NRSV, CEV “Meraioth”). Cf. v. 3.

verses.zh: 易多族有撒迦利亚；近顿族有米书兰；
verses.en: of Iddo,[NOTE:1] Zechariah; of Ginnethon, Meshullam;
notes: The present translation (along with most English versions) reads with the Qere and the Syriac Peshitta לְעִדּוֹא (leʿiddoʾ, “Iddo”) rather than the MT reading לַעֲדָיָא (laʿadayaʾ) which probably arose through graphic confusion. Cf. v. 4.

verses.zh: 亚比雅族有细基利；米拿民族某；摩亚底族有毗勒太；
verses.en: of Abijah, Zicri; of Miniamin and[NOTE:1] of Moadiah, Piltai;
notes: Or “of Miniamin,…; of Moadiah, Piltai,” where the name of the leader of the family of Miniamin has dropped out of the text due to a problem in transmission.

verses.zh: 璧迦族有沙母亚；示玛雅族有约拿单；
verses.en: of Bilgah, Shammua; of Shemaiah, Jehonathan;

verses.zh: 约雅立族有玛特乃；耶大雅族有乌西；
verses.en: of Joiarib, Mattenai; of Jedaiah, Uzzi;

verses.zh: 撒来族有加莱；亚木族有希伯；
verses.en: of Sallu,[NOTE:1] Kallai; of Amok, Eber;
notes: The present translation reads סַלּוּ (sallu, cf. NAB, NIV, NCV, NLT “Sallu”) rather than the MT reading סַלַּי (sallai, cf. KJV, NASB, NRSV, CEV “Sallai”) . Cf. v. 7.

verses.zh: 希勒家族有哈沙比雅；耶大雅族有拿坦业。
verses.en: of Hilkiah, Hashabiah; of Jedaiah, Nethanel.

verses.zh: 至于利未人，当以利亚实、耶何耶大、约哈难、押杜亚的时候，他们的族长记在册上。波斯王大流士在位的时候，作族长的祭司也记在册上。
verses.en: As for the Levites,[NOTE:1] in the days of Eliashib, Joiada, Johanan, and Jaddua the heads of families were recorded, as were the priests during the reign of Darius the Persian.
notes: Some scholars delete these words, regarding them as a later scribal addition to the text.

verses.zh: 利未人作族长的记在历史上，直到以利亚实的儿子约哈难的时候。
verses.en: The descendants of Levi were recorded in the Book of the Chronicles[NOTE:1] as heads of families up to the days of Johanan son of Eliashib.
notes: Or “the Book of the Official Records”; NRSV “the Book of the Annals”; NLT “The Book of History.”

verses.zh: 利未人的族长是哈沙比雅、示利比、甲篾的儿子耶书亚，与他们弟兄的班次相对，照着神人大卫的命令一班一班地赞美称谢。
verses.en: And the leaders of the Levites were Hashabiah, Sherebiah, Jeshua son of Kadmiel, and their colleagues, who stood opposite them to offer praise and thanks, one contingent corresponding to the other, as specified by[NOTE:1] David the man of God.
notes: Heb “in [accord with] the commandment of.”

verses.zh: 玛他尼、八布迦、俄巴底亚、米书兰、达们、亚谷是守门的，就是在库房那里守门。
verses.en: Mattaniah, Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon, and Akkub were gatekeepers who were guarding the storerooms at the gates.

verses.zh: 这都是在约撒达的孙子、耶书亚的儿子约雅金和省长尼希米，并祭司文士以斯拉的时候，有职任的。
verses.en: These all served in the days of Joiakim son of Jeshua, the son of Jozadak, and in the days of Nehemiah the governor and of Ezra the priestly scribe.[NOTE:1]
notes: Heb “the priest, the scribe.”

verses.zh: 耶路撒冷城墙告成的时候，众民就把各处的利未人招到耶路撒冷，要称谢、歌唱、敲钹、鼓瑟、弹琴，欢欢喜喜地行告成之礼。
verses.en: At the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem,[NOTE:1] they sought out the Levites from all the places they lived[NOTE:2] to bring them to Jerusalem to celebrate the dedication joyfully with songs of thanksgiving and songs accompanied by cymbals, harps, and lyres.
notes: For location see Map5-B1; Map6-F3; Map7-E2; Map8-F2; Map10-B3; JP1-F4; JP2-F4; JP3-F4; JP4-F4.
Heb “from all their places.” The words “they lived” are implied.

verses.zh: 歌唱的人从耶路撒冷的周围和尼陀法的村庄与伯・吉甲，又从迦巴和押玛弗的田地聚集，因为歌唱的人在耶路撒冷四围为自己立了村庄。
verses.en: The singers[NOTE:1] were also assembled from the district around Jerusalem and from the settlements of the Netophathites
notes: Heb “the sons of the singers.”

verses.zh: a
verses.en: and from Beth Gilgal and from the fields of Geba and Azmaveth, for the singers had built settlements for themselves around Jerusalem.

verses.zh: 祭司和利未人就洁净自己，也洁净百姓和城门，并城墙。
verses.en: When the priests and Levites had purified themselves, they purified the people, the gates, and the wall.

verses.zh: 我带犹大的首领上城，使称谢的人分为两大队，排列而行：第一队在城上往右边向粪厂门行走，
verses.en: I brought the leaders of Judah up on top of the wall, and I appointed two large choirs to give thanks. One was to proceed[NOTE:1] on the top of the wall southward toward the Dung Gate.
notes: The translation reads וְהָאַחַת הֹלֶכֶת (vehaʾakhat holekhet, “and one was proceeding”) rather than the MT reading וְתַהֲלֻכֹת (vetahalukhot, “and processions”).

verses.zh: 在他们后头的有何沙雅与犹大首领的一半，
verses.en: Going after them were Hoshaiah, half the leaders of Judah,

verses.zh: 又有亚撒利雅、以斯拉、米书兰、
verses.en: Azariah, Ezra, Meshullam,

verses.zh: 犹大、便雅悯、示玛雅、耶利米。
verses.en: Judah, Benjamin, Shemaiah, Jeremiah,

verses.zh: 还有些吹号之祭司的子孙，约拿单的儿子撒迦利亚。约拿单是示玛雅的儿子；示玛雅是玛他尼的儿子；玛他尼是米该亚的儿子；米该亚是撒刻的儿子；撒刻是亚萨的儿子；
verses.en: some of the priests[NOTE:1] with trumpets, Zechariah son of Jonathan, the son of Shemaiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Micaiah, the son of Zaccur, the son of Asaph,
notes: Heb “some of the sons of the priests.”

verses.zh: 又有撒迦利亚的弟兄示玛雅、亚撒利、米拉莱、基拉莱、玛艾、拿坦业、犹大、哈拿尼，都拿着神人大卫的乐器，文士以斯拉引领他们。
verses.en: and his colleagues—Shemaiah, Azarel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethanel, Judah, and Hanani—with musical instruments of[NOTE:1] David the man of God. (Ezra the scribe led them.)[NOTE:2]
notes: Or “prescribed by” (NIV, NLT); TEV “of the kind played by.” The precise relationship of these musical instruments to David is not clear.
Heb “was before them.”

verses.zh: 他们经过泉门往前，从大卫城的台阶随地势而上，在大卫宫殿以上，直行到朝东的水门。
verses.en: They went over the Fountain Gate and continued directly up the steps of the City of David on the ascent to the wall. They passed the house of David and continued on to the Water Gate toward the east.

verses.zh: 第二队称谢的人要与那一队相迎而行。我和民的一半跟随他们，在城墙上过了炉楼，直到宽墙；
verses.en: The second choir was proceeding[NOTE:1] in the opposite direction. I followed them, along with half the people, on top of the wall, past the Tower of the Ovens to the Broad Wall,
notes: The translation reads הוֹלֶכֶת (holekhet, “was proceeding”) rather than the MT הַהוֹלֶכֶת (haholekhet, “the one proceeding”). The MT probably reflects dittography—accidental writing of ה (hey) twice instead of once.

verses.zh: 又过了以法莲门、古门、鱼门、哈楠业楼、哈米亚楼，直到羊门，就在护卫门站住。
verses.en: over the Ephraim Gate, the Jeshanah Gate,[NOTE:1] the Fish Gate, the Tower of Hananel, and the Tower of the Hundred, to the Sheep Gate. They stopped[NOTE:2] at the Gate of the Guard.
notes: Or “the Old Gate” (so KJV, NASB, NCV, NRSV).
Heb “they stood.”

verses.zh: 于是，这两队称谢的人连我和官长的一半，站在　神的殿里。
verses.en: Then the two choirs that gave thanks took their stations[NOTE:1] in the temple of God. I did also, along with half the officials with me,
notes: Heb “stood.”

verses.zh: 还有祭司以利亚金、玛西雅、米拿民、米该亚、以利约乃、撒迦利亚、哈楠尼亚吹号；
verses.en: and the priests—Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Micaiah, Elioenai, Zechariah, and Hananiah, with their trumpets—

verses.zh: 又有玛西雅、示玛雅、以利亚撒、乌西、约哈难、玛基雅、以拦，和以谢奏乐。歌唱的就大声歌唱，伊斯拉希雅管理他们。
verses.en: and also Maaseiah, Shemaiah, Eleazar, Uzzi, Jehohanan, Malkijah, Elam, and Ezer. The choirs sang loudly[NOTE:1] under the direction of Jezrahiah.
notes: Heb “caused to hear.”

verses.zh: 那日，众人献大祭而欢乐；因为　神使他们大大欢乐，连妇女带孩童也都欢乐，甚至耶路撒冷中的欢声听到远处。
verses.en: And on that day they offered great sacrifices and rejoiced, for God had given them great joy. The women and children also rejoiced. The rejoicing in Jerusalem could be heard from far away.

verses.zh: 当日，派人管理库房，将举祭、初熟之物和所取的十分之一，就是按各城田地，照律法所定归给祭司和利未人的分，都收在里头。犹大人因祭司和利未人供职，就欢乐了。
verses.en: On that day men were appointed over the storerooms for the contributions, firstfruits, and tithes, to gather into them from[NOTE:1] the fields of the cities the portions prescribed by the law for the priests and the Levites, for the people of Judah[NOTE:2] took delight in the priests and Levites who were ministering.[NOTE:3]
notes: The translation reads מִשְּׂדֵי (missede, “from the fields”) rather than the MT reading לִשְׂדֵי (lisde, “to the fields”).
Heb “for Judah.” The words “the people of” have been supplied in the translation for clarity, since “Judah” is a proper name as well as a place name.
Heb “standing.”

verses.zh: 祭司利未人遵守　神所吩咐的，并守洁净的礼。歌唱的、守门的，照着大卫和他儿子所罗门的命令也如此行。
verses.en: They performed the service of their God and the service of purification, along with the singers and gatekeepers, according to the commandment of David and[NOTE:1] his son Solomon.
notes: With many medieval Hebrew MSS and the ancient versions the translation reads the conjunction (“and”). It is absent in the Leningrad MS that forms the textual basis for BHS.

verses.zh: 古时，在大卫和亚萨的日子，有歌唱的伶长，并有赞美称谢　神的诗歌。
verses.en: For long ago, in the days of David and Asaph, there had been directors[NOTE:1] for the singers and for the songs of praise and thanks to God.
notes: Heb “heads.” The translation reads with the Qere the plural רֹאשֵׁי (roʾshe, “heads”) rather than the Kethib singular רֹאשׁ (roʾsh, “head”) of the MT.

verses.zh: 当所罗巴伯和尼希米的时候，以色列众人将歌唱的、守门的，每日所当得的分供给他们，又给利未人当得的分；利未人又给亚伦的子孙当得的分。
verses.en: So in the days of Zerubbabel and in the days of Nehemiah, all Israel was contributing the portions for the singers and gatekeepers, according to the daily need.[NOTE:1] They also set aside[NOTE:2] the portion for the Levites, and the Levites set aside the portion for the descendants of Aaron.
notes: Heb “a thing of a day in its day.”
Heb “were sanctifying.”
